en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a large waterfront mansion-like building identified as the English Embassy, standing on a shore with trees to the left and hills across a wide body of water. A boat or small ship sails on the right. The style is late‑19th/early‑20th‑century, and there is printed caption text in French at the bottom left and additional text in Arabic script at the bottom right, along with a faint website watermark.
